Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
Yes, damaged items are handled differently from standard returns.
For most food products (like dried or freeze-dried items), we cannot accept general return requests once opened due to food safety rules. However, if an item arrives damaged or defective, we will investigate and arrange a replacement for you.
To handle a damaged item, we require photos of the damaged product and its packaging to submit to Quality Assurance within 24 hours of delivery. Standard returns for non-food items require a return authorization number instead.

menu

Can I keep the damaged item or must I ship it back?
menu
You do not need to ship damaged food items back to us. Because we sell food products, we cannot take back opened or handled food due to safety rules.
As long as you retain the damaged item and its packaging long enough to take clear photos for Quality Assurance, you do not need to return the physical product.
